verdict.rationale: Bruno's CLI and CI/CD/Docker integration let collections be run unattended inside pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), which can serve as background automation, but there's no evidence of a native scheduler, cron, or agent-triggered autonomous execution inside Bruno itself — automation only runs when an external CI system invokes it. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/cron capability, evidence of unattended background runs outside CI/CD, and confirmation that AI-driven automations can be set to run autonomously without external triggers.
